title: Optic toggle
description: A glass light switch bends the patterned surface beneath its rounded edge.
useCase: Give a familiar on/off control convincing optical depth while preserving native input behavior.
reducedMotion: The switch changes position and illumination immediately.
limitations: Rounded-edge SVG backdrop displacement is enhanced in Chromium; other browsers use translucent blur. No optical ray tracing or capture of the page into an image.
look: A clear glass pill switch with a lensed thumb and lime indicator dot over orange and black diagonal hazard stripes, darkened at the edges.
motion: Clicking slides the glass thumb 72 px in 260 ms with an ease-out while its rim refracts the stripes beneath; the striped field brightens or dims over 240 ms.
adapt: Thumb slide and field dimming are CSS on `.ot-thumb` and `.ot-field` keyed by `data-on`; refraction is an `feDisplacementMap` (tune `scale`) over the edge map `measure` draws, Chromium-only via `enhanced`. Replace the striped `.ot-field` backdrop and labels.
